title: Quick Steamed Greek Cabbage Salad
description: A refreshing and light salad featuring steamed savoy cabbage, cherry tomatoes, and a zesty Greek vinaigrette.
instructions: Bring 2 cups of water to a boil in a medium saucepan over high heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of lemon juice and 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the water.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and add the sliced red onion to the saucepan.
Steam the onion for 3-5 minutes, or until slightly softened.
Add the cabbage to the saucepan and steam for an additional 3-5 minutes, or until slightly tender.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it cool for 1 minute.
Transfer the cabbage and onion to a large bowl.
Add the chopped parsley, dill, cherry tomatoes, feta cheese, kosher salt, and black pepper to the bowl.
Toss the salad gently to combine.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley and dill if desired.
